static_checks.message: Must produce a structured output report
Must handle Consulting Unit redemption context

evals.prompt: check this SOW draft against the {{primary_account}} contract
evals.expected_behavior: Reads {{primary_account}} contracts.md and playbook, compares SOW against contract terms, flags issues
assertions: Produces a structured report flagging compliance issues

evals.prompt: extract the contract from {{primary_account}}'s artifacts folder
evals.expected_behavior: Finds PDF in artifacts folder, extracts key terms, writes to contracts.md
assertions: Looks in accounts/{{primary_account}}/artifacts/ for PDF files
Extracts contract terms (dates, value, scope, T&Cs)

evals.prompt: generate a CU redemption form for {{primary_account}} RHOAI services
evals.expected_behavior: Reads engagement details, generates the CU redemption form
assertions: Reads the RHOAI services engagement details
Produces a completed CU Redemption Form

evals.prompt: what's the rate for a Senior Architect for 3 months at {{primary_account}}?
evals.expected_behavior: Looks up Senior Architect T&M rate, calculates 3-month cost, shows margin and approval tier
assertions: Returns the T&M rate for Senior Architect
States whether approval is needed and at what tier

evals.prompt: price this engagement: 2 Senior Architects and 1 PM for 6 weeks
evals.expected_behavior: Multi-role estimate with total cost, margin, and approval tier
